The changelog for one version or many, read from the release service. Notes render as text with real list markup, never as disc-bulleted raw text.

<ComponentStates component="ReleaseNotes" />

<KitBaselines component="ReleaseNotes" />

## In each kit

<Tabs syncKey="ui-kit">
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Python)">
    <KitStatus kit="terminal-python" />

    **Drop-in.** `changelog [--limit n]`.

    **Styled part.** `screens.release_notes(kit, view)` in `polaris_key.ui.terminal`, drawn with a `Kit`; restyle through
    `Theme(colors=…, symbols=…, preset="native")`.

    **Headless.** `release_notes_view(entries)` → `ReleaseNotesView` in `polaris_key.ui.core.models`.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Node)">
    <KitStatus kit="terminal-node" />

    **Drop-in.** `changelog` (`changelogFlow`): the published releases, newest first, dated in the
    active locale (`list`, `empty`, `error`).

    **Styled part.** `stepRow` and `textRow`.

    **Headless.** None of its own: the data is `client.release.changelog()`.

    [Terminal (Node)](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/terminal-node/) has the adapter's options, the
    `--json` contract and the fallbacks.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="SwiftUI">
    <KitStatus kit="swiftui" />

    **Drop-in.** A host pushes `ReleaseNotesView` from its own settings or About screen.

    **Styled part.** `ReleaseNotesView(screen:notes:onRetry:)`: notes are plain text, never markup that runs.

    **Headless.** `KitStates.releaseNotes(_:)`.

    [SwiftUI](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/swiftui/) has the theme, the restyle hooks and the sample.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Electron">
    <KitStatus kit="electron" />

    **Drop-in.** A host places `<ReleaseNotes />` from `@polaris-key/react/kit`, given an `input`.

    **Styled part.** The React kit's `<ReleaseNotes />`, drawn in the macOS, Windows or GNOME chrome with `theme.platform: "auto"`; restyle through `data-part` and the `--pk-*` hooks.

    **Headless.** `viewOf("ReleaseNotes", input)`.

    [Electron](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/electron/) has the bridge, the menu and the sample.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Compose">
    <KitStatus kit="compose" />

    **Drop-in.** `PolarisKitScreen` draws the changelog when the screen is ReleaseNotes and the rows carry the notes.

    **Styled part.** `PolarisReleaseNotes(screen, notes, onRetry)`: one card per version, the date in the reader's style, notes as plain text.

    **Headless.** `KitStates.resolve(KitComponent.releaseNotes, inputs)` and `KitReleaseNote(version, date, notes)`.

    ```kotlin android
    import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
    import im.plrs.key.ui.KitComponent
    import im.plrs.key.ui.KitInputs
    import im.plrs.key.ui.KitReleaseNote
    import im.plrs.key.ui.KitStates
    import im.plrs.key.ui.PolarisReleaseNotes

    @Composable
    fun MyReleaseNotes(inputs: KitInputs, notes: List<KitReleaseNote>, retry: () -> Unit) {
        PolarisReleaseNotes(KitStates.resolve(KitComponent.releaseNotes, inputs), notes, onRetry = retry)
    }
    ```

    [Compose](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/compose/) has the one-liner, the sample and the routes; Compose Desktop opens the same screens in OS windows.

  </TabItem>

    <KitStatus kit="godot" />

  </TabItem>
</Tabs>
